rules.description: prototype description: drop the 'short' intake cap
stock: Run a short intake, state your assumptions, build, then iterate on feedback in the same artifact.
unnerf: Run the intake, state your assumptions, build, then iterate on feedback in the same artifact.

rules.description: prototype intake: drop the 2-4-question cap and the one-message limit
stock: two to four questions, each a single pointed sentence, in
unnerf: as many questions as the ambiguity genuinely requires, each a single pointed sentence

rules.description: prototype assumptions: drop the 'one short message' cap
stock: Before building, send one short message: what you take the idea to be,
unnerf: Before building, send a message covering what you take the idea to be,

rules.description: prototype publish: drop the 'one or two lines' cap
stock: Give the user the link plus one or two lines: what the prototype shows,
what is faked, and the obvious next step.
unnerf: Give the user the link plus a summary of what the prototype shows,
what is faked, and the obvious next step.

stock: short list of what a real build would still need that the prototype
unnerf: complete list of what a real build would still need that the prototype
